520:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader's Private Room ～

520:t_1:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that's the truth hidden in $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

520:t_1:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You could call it, quite literally, the existence of God.」

520:t_1:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「And protecting it is the doctrine of $$クロノ$$...」

520:t_1:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Though at this point it is merely my conjecture.」

520:t_1:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「However, I also get the feeling that $$ラプラスの箱$$ hides more than I have surmised.」

520:t_1:11.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Otherwise, I cannot explain why, in this multiverse, $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ placed such weight on the Box.」

520:t_1:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「A conjecture is still a conjecture.」

520:t_1:13.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Yes... The truth will have to wait until we have the Box in hand.」

520:t_1:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「And then prove your own strength exceeds that of $$クロノ$$, and take its place...?」

520:t_1:15.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you think that servile?」

520:t_1:17.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As harsh as ever, I see.」

520:t_1:18.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now, our positions are reversed.」

520:t_1:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I sit in the seat of Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, while you might as well be a prisoner. Your life and death are in my hands.」

520:t_1:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you intend to kill me, what was the point of telling me your own theory on $$ラプラス$$? Surely you don't mean it as a parting gift?」

520:t_1:21.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Perhaps I want to confirm who I am.」

520:t_1:23.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You risked your life to see through my true nature. Surely you can understand?」

520:t_1:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You have probably already looked into it, but originally I was merely one of your clones.」

520:t_1:26.en:
$$シャア$$
「So there are other men besides you who were prepared to be my decoys...」

520:t_1:27.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But the 《$$新世時空震動$$》 changed everything.」

520:t_1:28.en:
$$シャア$$
「I take it that at that time, the consciousness of my counterpart in a parallel world flowed into you.」

520:t_1:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It sounds occult, but that explanation feels right to me as well.」

520:t_1:30.en:
$$シャア$$
「Personal matters only I could know... and at the same time, a me that I do not know.」

520:t_1:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「If one is to describe you, who know both, there is no other way to put it.」

520:t_1:32.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then I'll ask. Who are you?」

520:t_1:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you $$シャア・アズナブル$$? Or are you $$フル・フロンタル$$?」

520:t_1:35.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「My answer is what I said a moment ago.」

520:t_1:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「You want to confirm yourself... So even you don't know what you are.」

520:t_1:37.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is my consciousness my own, or is it $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s...? Even within myself, I cannot tell.」

520:t_1:38.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is exactly why I want to cherish the present, in which I myself exist.」

520:t_1:39.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Continuing this moment called 'now' matters more than seeking an unstable future.」

520:t_1:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「Is that why you sided with the $$サイデリアル$$?」

520:t_1:41.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You of all people can understand that it is the most efficient choice for humanity.」

520:t_1:43.en:
$$シャア$$
「But it is only one option among many, and I will never choose it.」

520:t_1:44.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...As I thought, the existence of $$アムロ・レイ$$ and $c seems to be warping you.」

520:t_1:45.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Personally, I thought things would go more smoothly if I put you, the purer $$シャア・アズナブル$$, at the front.」

520:t_1:46.en:
$$シャア$$
「You must have learned over these past few weeks that trying to win me over is futile.」

520:t_1:47.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Yes. Using any form of mind control would damage the charisma you possess.」

520:t_1:48.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That being the case, I judge that removing what is warping you is the most efficient way to welcome you as a comrade.」

520:t_1:49.en:
$$シャア$$
「You intend to eliminate $$アムロ$$ and $c?」

520:t_1:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Moving a weakened $$ネオ・ジオン$$ would not be wise.」

520:t_1:51.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But battle is not decided by force alone.」

520:t_1:52.en:
$$シャア$$
「I can't say I like that smile of yours.」

520:t_1:53.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Does it feel as if your own unpleasant side is being thrust in your face?」

520:t_1:55.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let us go, $$シャア・アズナブル$$. For the sake of what lies ahead, the time has come to settle matters with the ties that bind you.」

520:t_1:56.en:
$$シャア$$
(This man... may be more dangerous than I imagined...)

520:t_1:61.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...Still, what I can't figure out is what that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ guy is thinking.」

520:t_1:62.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Has he... really become our enemy after all...?」

520:t_1:63.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What's with you, $$ヒルデ$$? You still believe in that guy?」

520:t_1:64.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「It's not that, but I just can't believe he's really a bad person...」

520:t_1:65.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I understand how you feel, $$ヒルデ$$.」

520:t_1:66.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Do you feel the same, $$セツコ$$?」

520:t_1:67.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Somewhere in my heart, I want to believe in $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ too...」

520:t_1:68.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Then isn't it okay to be honest about that feeling?」

520:t_1:70.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I think he's got something in common with my dad. That way he pushes his own ideas on you high-handedly, without a proper explanation...」

520:t_1:71.en:
$$エマ$$
「Are you saying that what he did was for our sake?」

520:t_1:72.en:
$$カツ$$
「Then he's doing all that to train us...!」

520:t_1:74.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I don't really know why he would do that, though.」

520:t_1:75.en:
$$トロワ$$
「True, $$プラント$$'s reason for attacking was far too childish.」

520:t_1:76.en:
$$五飛$$
「Punishing anyone who won't follow your will... It's like a child's logic.」

520:t_1:77.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You mean that was just a convenient excuse to pick a fight with us...?」

520:t_1:78.en:
$$カトル$$
「Even if that's so, dragging the people of $$プラント$$ into danger for that purpose is unforgivable.」

520:t_1:79.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Agreed. Even as a prank, it went too far.」

520:t_1:80.en:
$$五飛$$
「Besides, I don't like that he treated $n like a possession.」

520:t_1:81.en:
$$ファ$$
「I wonder what $n himself thinks about it...」

520:t_1:82.en:
$$フォウ$$
「He seems to have been brooding a little since the battle at $$プラント$$...」

520:t_1:84.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you thinking about that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ person?」

520:t_1:85.en:
$n
「I think there's no point in thinking about him.」
